I finally got around to assembling it and it was much harder than it should have been. Two of the legs were bent. I was missing two screws from the A bag which turned up in the F bag. The folding shelf is flimsy and difficult to use moving the grill, and the plastic feet fall off if they push just a bit on a hard surface. To top it all off, I tried to put on the cover that was clearly marked Spirit 2 and it turned out to be one for a kettle Grill. I hope this thing cooks a lot better then it was to assemble. To sum it up, it is poorly engineered and has parts that can fit backwards. I am a good mechanic with a lot of spatial skills, and did get it together properly but without much help from the Rinky Dink instructions.

My wife and I have always wanted a Weber grill.  The Spirit II model brought affordability into the realm.  It is so much better constructed than other gas grills that we've owned.  Plus, the propane tank mounts quickly and easily and the weight gauge is accurate!  This grill heats up very fast, so food is on the table in short order.

Our Spirit II came with the most concise owners manual we've ever gotten with a grill.  We bought the fitted cover for our grill and it works great!  We are considering the iGrill 3 app.  Our dealer assembled and delivered our grill, certainly an added bonus.  Weber provides cooking tips and tips on caring for the grill through it's emails.

All in all this has been a great experience to date!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
